summary: Alphabet Inc. filed a routine Form 8-K (Items 8.01 and 9.01) dated November 5, 2026, covering other events and financial statements/exhibits. The filing's cover page enumerates the registrant's listed securities—Class A (GOOGL) and Class C (GOOG) common stock, 6.25% Series A and Series B mandatory convertible preferred depositary shares (GOOGM, GOOGN), and a long schedule of senior notes across maturities from 2028 to 2126—but the excerpt discloses no transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or closing date. This is ordinary capital-structure disclosure rather than a special situation; no deal terms are stated and no risk-arb angle applies.
